questions.question: A student has ₹500 in her savings bank account. She gets ₹150 every month as pocket money. How much money will she have at the end of every month from the second month onwards? Find a linear expression to represent the amount she will have in the nth month.

solution.content: **Understand the situation:** The student starts with ₹500. Every month she adds ₹150 to her account.
**Amount at the end of each month:** At the end of month 1: $500 + 150 = 650$. At the end of month 2: $500 + 2 \times 150 = 800$. At the end of month 3: $500 + 3 \times 150 = 950$, and so on.
**Find the pattern:** The amount at the end of the $n$th month is: $$500 + 150n$$
**Check that it is linear:** The expression $500 + 150n$ is a linear polynomial in $n$ (degree 1). Each month the amount increases by the constant ₹150.

questions.answer: Amount at the end of the $n$th month $= 500 + 150n$ rupees. (Month 1: ₹650, Month 2: ₹800, Month 3: ₹950, ...)

formulaBox.title: Linear Pattern
formulaBox.content: $$\text{Amount after } n \text{ months} = \text{starting amount} + (\text{monthly addition}) \times n$$

questions.notes: **Exam Tip:** In a linear pattern, the coefficient of $n$ is the constant amount added each time, and the constant term is the starting value.

questions.question: A rally starts with 120 members. Each hour, 9 members drop out of the group. How many members will remain after 1, 2, 3, ... hours? Find a linear expression to represent the number of members at the end of the nth hour.

solution.content: **Understand the situation:** The rally starts with 120 members and loses 9 members every hour.
**Members remaining after each hour:** After 1 hour: $120 - 9 = 111$. After 2 hours: $120 - 2 \times 9 = 102$. After 3 hours: $120 - 3 \times 9 = 93$, and so on.
**Find the pattern:** The number of members at the end of the $n$th hour is: $$120 - 9n$$
**Check that it is linear:** The expression $120 - 9n$ is a linear polynomial in $n$ (degree 1). Each hour the number decreases by the constant 9.

questions.answer: Members remaining after $n$ hours $= 120 - 9n$. (After 1 h: 111, after 2 h: 102, after 3 h: 93, ...)
questions.notes: **Common Mistake:** Students sometimes write $9n - 120$. The order matters: we start with 120 and subtract 9 each hour, so it is $120 - 9n$.

questions.question: Suppose the length of a rectangle is 13 cm. Find the area if the breadth is **(i)** 12 cm, **(ii)** 10 cm, **(iii)** 8 cm. Find the linear pattern representing the area of the rectangle.

solution.content: **Recall the area formula:** $$\text{Area of a rectangle} = \text{length} \times \text{breadth}$$
**(i) Breadth = 12 cm:** $$\text{Area} = 13 \times 12 = 156 \text{ cm}^2$$
**(ii) Breadth = 10 cm:** $$\text{Area} = 13 \times 10 = 130 \text{ cm}^2$$
**(iii) Breadth = 8 cm:** $$\text{Area} = 13 \times 8 = 104 \text{ cm}^2$$

**Find the linear pattern:** If the breadth is $b$ cm, then the area is $A = 13b$. This is a linear polynomial in $b$ (degree 1). As the breadth decreases by 2 cm, the area decreases by $13 \times 2 = 26$ cm², a constant amount.

questions.notes: **Exam Tip:** When the length is fixed, the area varies linearly with the breadth. The slope of the pattern is the fixed length (13).

questions.question: Suppose the length of a rectangular box is 7 cm and breadth is 11 cm. Find the volume if the height is **(i)** 5 cm, **(ii)** 9 cm, **(iii)** 13 cm. Find the linear pattern representing the volume of the rectangular box.

solution.content: **Recall the volume formula:** $$\text{Volume of a cuboid} = \text{length} \times \text{breadth} \times \text{height}$$
**Base area:** The base area is $7 \times 11 = 77$ cm². So the volume is $77 \times \text{height}$.
**(i) Height = 5 cm:** $$\text{Volume} = 77 \times 5 = 385 \text{ cm}^3$$
**(ii) Height = 9 cm:** $$\text{Volume} = 77 \times 9 = 693 \text{ cm}^3$$
**(iii) Height = 13 cm:** $$\text{Volume} = 77 \times 13 = 1001 \text{ cm}^3$$

**Find the linear pattern:** If the height is $h$ cm, then the volume is $V = 77h$. This is a linear polynomial in $h$ (degree 1). As the height increases by 4 cm, the volume increases by $77 \times 4 = 308$ cm³, a constant amount.

questions.notes: **Exam Tip:** When length and breadth are fixed, the volume varies linearly with the height. The slope of the volume pattern is the base area (77).

questions.question: Sarita is reading a book of 500 pages. She reads 20 pages every day. How many pages will be left after 15 days? Express this as a linear pattern.

solution.content: **Understand the situation:** The book has 500 pages. Sarita reads 20 pages each day, so after $d$ days she has read $20d$ pages.
**Pages left after $d$ days:** $$\text{Pages left} = 500 - 20d$$
**Pages left after 15 days:** $$500 - 20 \times 15 = 500 - 300 = 200$$
**Express as a linear pattern:** The expression $500 - 20d$ is a linear polynomial in $d$ (degree 1). Each day the number of pages left decreases by the constant 20.

questions.answer: After 15 days, **200 pages** will be left. Linear pattern: pages left $= 500 - 20d$.
questions.notes: **Common Mistake:** Students sometimes compute $500 - 20 = 480$ and then multiply. Remember: read pages after 15 days is $20 \times 15 = 300$, so pages left is $500 - 300 = 200$.
